text:
Priya Shah: :rotating_light: SolaraHealth flagged p99 embeddings > 2s on dedicated pool d-pool-04, customer warned SLA breach by EOD PST if not mitigated. Need owners and a short mitigation timeline.
Aaron Patel: on it, pulling metrics now. can anyone confirm if this is new traffic profile or regressions?
Jordan Malik: oncall - seeing KV cache thrash and lots of retransmits around 13:02 UTC. some nodes hitting high mem + GC. logs snippet below.
Jordan Malik: ```
2026-03-17T13:02:11Z node-04 kernel: OutOfMemory killed process llama_infer (pid 2345)
2026-03-17T13:02:12Z inference: kv_cache_evictions=4821 seq=2048
```
Samir Rao: SRE - autoscaler seems to have downscaled some reserve nodes last night; checking scaling decisions around midnight window. may be compounding the KV cache warmup.
Leo Kim: Runtime - we can route a small percentage of requests to a quantized variant (q4_1) as fallback to reduce per-token time while we stabilize. propose quick routing change + canary.
Mei Chen: Infra - I can run the canary policy and pin routing for 10% traffic to the q4_1 model for SolaraHealth. Will coordinate with release window. ETA 10m.
Aaron Patel: who will handle customer comms and rollback if canary worsens? need a single owner to update CS.
Priya Shah: owners: Mei -> canary deployment, Leo -> routing + model validation, Samir -> autoscaler policy tweak, Jordan -> incident doc & logs, Aaron -> CS updates. I will coordinate exec updates.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for solara-prod routing (ticket #INC-6218). status=starting
Mei Chen: started canary at 13:15 UTC, 10% traffic. early latency looks ~1.1s p99 on canary. pushing dashboards link: https://dash.redwood/solara/embeds
Leo Kim: routing snippet I'm applying: 
```json
{"routing_policy": "by-customer", "customer_id": "solara", "fallbacks": [{"model":"q4_1-embed","weight":0.10}], "grace_period_s": 600}
```
Samir Rao: I recommend a temporary autoscaler min_replicas bump on d-pool-04 from 3 -> 5 for 1 hour to avoid thrash while cache warms. Applying change now.
Jordan Malik: noted one more log sample after canary start: 
```
2026-03-17T13:18:02Z node-03 inference: latency=2150ms request_id=abc123
2026-03-17T13:18:05Z node-03 kernel: pgfault spike=120
```
Aaron Patel: timeline: canary started 13:15, autoscaler bump applied 13:20, we reconvene 13:45 UTC for metrics check and decide to expand or roll back. I'll ping CS after 13:45 with status.
Priya Shah: perfect. if canary p99 stays <1.5s and no OOMs, we expand to 30% then full roll. if errors or OOMs continue, immediate rollback to previous routing and keep autoscaler bump.
Mei Chen: canary metrics at 13:30 show error rate unchanged, p99 embed latency 1.08s for canary traffic. expanding to 30% in 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary update: traffic=30% status=healthy
Leo Kim: validating model outputs quickly for quality drift - running small eval set. will report anomalies in 5m.
Samir Rao: autoscaler min_replicas change will remain for 60m, then revert. documenting change in infra runbook.
Aaron Patel: CS update sent: "We have a targeted canary and autoscaler change; early signals are positive; next update at 13:45 UTC."
Jordan Malik: adding incident note and attaching log excerpts.
Priya Shah: thanks everyone. check-in 13:45 UTC. if anyone sees regressions before that, @channel ping. :thumbsup:
